visible.title: PlantAgent — checked plant-change engineering
visible.heading: Muse proposes. Physics checks. Engineers approve.
visible.bodySample: PlantAgent Case library Study replay Plant-change engineering with the working shown Muse proposes. Physics checks. Engineers approve. PlantAgent turns a plant-change goal into a checked draft design. Muse reads the drawings and proposes the change; DWSIM, pandapower, WaterTAP and Cantera re-solve it, return failed checks with numbers, and stop only when the run passes or records what remains open. Start the 3-minute demo See the grid and LNG incidents Existing case workspaces. Engineering outpu
